sourceTitle: Cambridge IGCSE and O Level Computer Science, Second Edition
sourceNote: The 2021 Hodder Computer Science (0478/0984/2210) Student Book was scanned across 404 PDF pages (including cover, introductory material and index). All 10 body chapters, printed pages 2–386 except section-divider p.257, were screened for important instructional terms beyond chapter-end Key Terms. This glossary contains 354 editorially checked official Key Terms and 159 educational supplementary concepts, including 124 newly curated from the chapter body text. Supplementary English explanations are original editorial paraphrases supported by section and printed page; they are NOT verbatim publisher Key Terms definitions. Publisher typos are tracked. Complete refers to the curated core concepts, not every incidental phrase in the book.
numberingNote: Subsection page bounds are containing section ranges based on the Hodder printed contents, not claimed precise start pages.
